english.title: Producer fail to notify Natural Resources Wales of relevant circumstances - Wales
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) was a producer of packaging waste as a corporate body that failed to inform Natural Resources Wales, as soon as was practicable upon becoming aware, that a relevant circumstance applied or was about to apply, namely

(A)_[a winding-up order had been made or a resolution for voluntary winding-up had been passed]_
(B)_[a determination for a voluntary winding-up had been made]_
(C)_[a receiver or a manager of the company or limited liability partnership’s undertaking had been duly appointed]_
(D)_[the undertaking had entered administration]_
(E)_[a voluntary arrangement proposed for the purposes of Part 1 of the Insolvency Act 1986 had been approved]_
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 18 and 28(2)(c) of the Packaging Waste (Data Collection and Reporting) (Wales) Regulations 2023.
english.pointstoprove: date and locationwas a producer of packaging wastethat failed to inform Natural Resources Wales, as soon as was practicable upon becoming aware,that a relevant circumstance applied or was about to apply,

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Please note, there is an error in regulation 28(2)(c) of the Packaging Waste (Data Collection and Reporting) (Wales) Regulations 2023 which creates this offence. Regulation 28(2)(c) refers to regulation 19 however, this appears to be an error and should in fact state regulation 18 as per the offence wording and details above.

other.penalty:
Either way Summary: a fine.
Indictment: a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
